extension.description: Manage Claude Swap (cswap) accounts and usage from VS Code.
view.accounts.name: Accounts
walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get Started with Cswap Manager
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: See the usage of every Claude account, switch the account Claude Code uses, and let cswap switch for you when one is used up.
walkthrough.installCswap.title: Install cswap (claude-swap)
walkthrough.installCswap.description:
Cswap Manager is a GUI for the [cswap](https://pypi.org/project/claude-swap/) command-line tool (the claude-swap package). **Install cswap…** runs `uv tool install claude-swap` (or `pipx install claude-swap`) in a terminal after you confirm, and refreshes when it is done. If cswap is installed somewhere VS Code does not look, set the path to `cswap.exe`.
[Install cswap…](command:cswapManager.installCswap)
[Refresh](command:cswapManager.refresh)
[Set the cswap Path](command:cswapManager.quickSettings?%5B%22cliPath%22%5D)
walkthrough.installCswap.altText: A terminal with the commands uv tool install claude-swap and pipx install claude-swap.
walkthrough.openAccounts.title: Open the Accounts view
walkthrough.openAccounts.description:
Every account cswap manages, in slot order: usage per window, time to the next reset and the name, lined up in columns. The active account has a green check and is expanded with its usage bars per window and per model.
[Open the Accounts View](command:cswapManager.accounts.focus)
walkthrough.openAccounts.altText: The Accounts view: each account's usage per window, time to reset and name in aligned columns.
walkthrough.addAccounts.title: Add your accounts
walkthrough.addAccounts.description:
Log in to an account with `/login` in Claude Code, then choose **Add Account…** and pick a free slot. When Claude Code is on an account cswap does not manage yet, the extension also offers **Add to cswap…** by itself. You can paste a setup-token (`claude setup-token`) instead of logging in.
[Add Account…](command:cswapManager.addAccount)
walkthrough.addAccounts.altText: The Add Account picker: log in to a new account, paste a setup-token or API key, or refresh a stored login.
walkthrough.switchAccounts.title: Switch accounts
walkthrough.switchAccounts.description:
Pick an account, or let cswap pick the one with the most headroom, in the switch picker: **Ctrl+Alt+S**, or click the account in the status bar. **Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S** switches straight to the next available account. Running Claude Code sessions use the new account from their next request. Turn on **Switch when an account is used up** and cswap moves you to another account at the limit instead of stopping.
[Switch Account…](command:cswapManager.quickSwitch)
[Switch When Used Up (On/Off)](command:cswapManager.toggleSwitchAtLimit)
walkthrough.switchAccounts.altText: The switch picker: pick automatically, the current account, available accounts and accounts at their limit.
walkthrough.dashboardAndSettings.title: Dashboard and Quick Settings
walkthrough.dashboardAndSettings.descrip:
The dashboard shows every account at once: suggestions with one-click switching, quota left, a sortable account table, the resets of the next 7 days and the details of each account. **Quick Settings** changes the language, status bar, refresh interval, auto-switch and more.
[Open Dashboard](command:cswapManager.openDashboard)
[Quick Settings…](command:cswapManager.quickSettings)
walkthrough.dashboardAndSettings.altText: The Cswap dashboard: suggestions, the active account, the account table and the 7-day reset timeline.

config.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the `cswap` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect from `PATH` and `~/.local/bin`. On Windows, point this at `cswap.exe`; `.cmd`/`.bat` shims are not supported because they would require running through a shell. Only user (machine) settings are honoured, never workspace settings.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds.descriptio: How often, in seconds, account data is refreshed while the Accounts view or the status bar item is shown and this window is focused. `0` turns automatic refresh off. Values below 30 are treated as 30.
config.sortOrder.description: Order of accounts in the sidebar. Slot order is the default.
config.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which the sidebar shows a warning colour. Display only — it does not change cswap's switching thresholds.
config.criticalThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which the sidebar shows a critical colour. Display only — it does not change cswap's switching thresholds.
config.commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time, in seconds, a single `cswap` command may run before it is stopped.
config.maxOutputKilobytes.description: Maximum size, in kilobytes, of `cswap` output the extension will read. Larger output is treated as an error.

config.autoSwitch.description: Automatic account switching with `cswap auto`, run by the extension while VS Code is open. `notify` only checks and tells you when cswap would switch; `switch` lets cswap switch the active Claude Code account by itself. The rules (threshold, cooldown, strategy) are cswap settings, editable from **Cswap: Auto-Switch…**. Only your user settings are honoured.
config.autoSwitch.notify: Check regularly and notify me when cswap would switch (dry run, never switches).
command.quickSettings.title: Quick Settings…
config.statusBarParts.description: What the status bar item shows when **Status Bar › Mode** is `custom`: `icon` (usage level), `slot`, `name` (display name or email), `plan`, `bar` (progress bar), `usage` (percentages) and `reset` (time to the next reset). Easiest to change from **Cswap: Quick Settings… › Status bar**, which previews it live.
config.statusBarCountdown.description: While automatic refresh runs, end the status bar item with the time left until the next refresh (`#3 · 7d 40% · 0:42`). Easiest to change from **Cswap: Quick Settings… › Status bar**.
config.statusBarColors.description: How the status bar item shows that an account is near or at its limit.
config.statusBarButtons.description: Buttons shown next to the account in the status bar: `refresh`, `dashboard` and `settings` (Quick Settings).
config.barStyle.description: Look of every usage progress bar: in the sidebar, the account switcher and the status bar.
command.setDisplayName.title: Set Display Name…
config.displayNames.description: Names shown instead of the email (capitals, spaces and accents allowed). Set them from an account's **Set Display Name…** action; they stay in VS Code and are never sent to cswap. Keys are short hashes that identify an account without storing its email.

command.clearUsageHistory.title: Clear Usage History
config.usageHistory.description: Record each account's usage after every refresh, to show the last 7 days on the dashboard (a small line per window and the measured usage per day; nothing is forecast). Readings stay in this computer's VS Code storage, keyed by a short hash of the account, never its email, and are kept for 8 days. **Cswap: Clear Usage History** deletes them.
config.checkCswapUpdates.description: Once a day, ask PyPI whether a newer cswap (claude-swap) is available, then update it (`#cswapManager.autoUpdateCswap#`) or offer to. Sends only a plain request for the package page.
config.autoUpdateCswap.description: When the daily check (`#cswapManager.checkCswapUpdates#`) or **Check for cswap Update** finds a newer cswap, update it in the background without asking: the uv or pipx that installed it is started directly (by its full path, no shell) with `tool upgrade claude-swap` / `upgrade claude-swap`, after any switch or account change. You are told the result. Turn off to be asked first.
config.notifyOnWeeklyReset.description: Show a notification when an account's weekly limit resets (its quota is full again), with a button to switch to it. Off by default. Easiest to change from **Cswap: Quick Settings… › Advanced… › Notifications…**.
config.notifyAtUsage.description: Warn when the active account reaches this usage in its fullest window (the limit that would stop it first), with buttons to switch to the account with the most quota left or to switch automatically when an account is used up. Shown once per account, window and reset period, and not while automatic switching is on. `0` turns it off. Easiest to change from **Cswap: Quick Settings… › Advanced… › Notifications…**.
config.notifyLoginExpiry.description: Remind you when an account's stored login expires within 3 days, and once it has expired, so you can log in to it again with `/login` in Claude Code (the extension then stores the new login). Shown once per account and login. Easiest to change from **Cswap: Quick Settings… › Advanced… › Notifications…**.
